snippet.title: Dosa Divas - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dosa Divas, a spicy narrative turn-based RPG, is out now for PC via Steam, Nintendo Switch 1 & Switch 2, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5.

Battle an evil fast food empire in this spicy narrative turn-based RPG. Two sisters and their upgradable spirit-mech cook delicious meals, fight corpos, build up reputation with local communities, and reconcile with loved ones.

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950710/Dosa_Divas/

Switch:
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/dosa-divas-switch/

Switch 2:
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/dosa-divas-switch-2/

PlayStation:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015953
